<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-and-live-in-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AdditionalDocumentsRequest" name="Request for additional documents"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SupplementaryDocuments" name="Supplementary documents"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaIssued" name="Visa issued"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaRefused" name="Visa refused"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAndLive">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Representation" name="Competent Austrian representation" processRef="Process_Representation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Visa application" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AdditionalRequest" name="Request additional documents" sourceRef="Task_RequestAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAdditionalRequest" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocumentsRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SupplementaryDocuments" name="Supplementary documents" sourceRef="Task_SendSupplementaryDocuments" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSupplementaryDocuments" messageRef="Message_SupplementaryDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_VisaIssued" name="Visa issued" sourceRef="Task_SendVisaIssued" targetRef="Task_ReceiveVisaIssued" messageRef="Message_VisaIssued"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_VisaRefused" name="Visa refused" sourceRef="Task_SendVisaRefused" targetRef="Task_ReceiveVisaRefused" messageRef="Message_VisaRefused"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_WorkAndLive" name="Plan work and life in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupSplit" name="Organize in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_VisaCycle" name="Apply for visa / Rot-Weiss-Rot Card (every x months)">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A further application is due after x months</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_VisaCycle" name="Begin visa application cycle"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact the representation in advance for information"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineVisaCategory" name="Determine visa category"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaCategory" name="Category A/C or type D?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineMainDestination" name="Determine Schengen main destination by length and purpose of stay, including equal-time stays"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MainDestination" name="Can the main destination be determined?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectMainDestination" name="Select the country of the main destination"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFirstEntry" name="Select the country of first entry into Schengen"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DestinationMerge" name="Continue with destination country"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompetenceAC" name="Identify the representation for the destination and the applicant's consular district of legal residence"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RegisteredInDistrict" name="Legally resident and registered in the district?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" name="Justify applying to that consulate; the representation may claim exceptional competence"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ACCompetenceMerge" name="Continue with category A/C application"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompetenceD" name="Identify the competent Austrian representation based on residence and centre of interest, verifiable by registration form, residence permit or visa"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CategoryMerge" name="Continue with the competent representation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareVisaForm" name="Prepare the visa application form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Check travel document validity, issue date and two empty pages"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePhoto" name="Prepare a compliant 35 x 45 mm passport photo"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInsurance" name="Obtain comprehensive travel health insurance for the full stay, at least 30,000 Euro, valid throughout Schengen"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Provide proof of sufficient means for the stay and return journey"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" name="Prepare location-specific evidence such as reservations, invitations, bookings, return ticket or employment proof"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SendApplication" name="Submit visa application"/>
      <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForVisaResponse" name="Wait for representation response"/>
      <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveVisaIssued" name="Receive visa issuance" messageRef="Message_VisaIssued"/>
      <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveVisaRefused" name="Receive visa refusal" messageRef="Message_VisaRefused"/>
      <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAdditionalRequest" name="Receive request for additional documents" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocumentsRequest"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments" name="Provide requested additional documents"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSupplementaryDocuments" name="Submit supplementary documents" messageRef="Message_SupplementaryDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaIssued" name="Visa issued"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaRefused" name="Visa refused"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V1" sourceRef="Start_VisaCycle" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V2" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Task_DetermineVisaCategory"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V3" sourceRef="Task_DetermineVisaCategory" targetRef="Gateway_VisaCategory"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V4" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_DetermineMainDestination" name="Category A/C"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V5" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_CompetenceD" name="Type D"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V6" sourceRef="Task_DetermineMainDestination" targetRef="Gateway_MainDestination"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V7" sourceRef="Gateway_MainDestination" targetRef="Task_SelectMainDestination" name="Yes"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V8" sourceRef="Gateway_MainDestination" targetRef="Task_SelectFirstEntry" name="No"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V9" sourceRef="Task_SelectMainDestination" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V10" sourceRef="Task_SelectFirstEntry" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V11" sourceRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge" targetRef="Task_CompetenceAC"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V12" sourceRef="Task_CompetenceAC" targetRef="Gateway_RegisteredInDistrict"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V13" sourceRef="Gateway_RegisteredInDistrict" targetRef="Gateway_ACCompetenceMerge" name="Yes"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V14" sourceRef="Gateway_RegisteredInDistrict" targetRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" name="No"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V15" sourceRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_ACCompetenceMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V16" sourceRef="Gateway_ACCompetenceMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CategoryMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V17" sourceRef="Task_CompetenceD" targetRef="Gateway_CategoryMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V18" sourceRef="Gateway_CategoryMerge" targetRef="Task_PrepareVisaForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V19" sourceRef="Task_PrepareVisaForm" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V20" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Task_PreparePhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V21" sourceRef="Task_PreparePhoto" targetRef="Task_ObtainInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V22" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V23" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V24" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" targetRef="Task_SendApplication"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V25" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForVisaResponse"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V26" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForVisaResponse" targetRef="Task_ReceiveVisaIssued"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V27" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForVisaResponse" targetRef="Task_ReceiveVisaRefused"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V28" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForVisaResponse" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAdditionalRequest"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V29" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveVisaIssued" targetRef="End_VisaIssued"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V30" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveVisaRefused" targetRef="End_VisaRefused"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V31" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAdditionalRequest" targetRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V32" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_SendSupplementaryDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V33" sourceRef="Task_SendSupplementaryDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForVisaResponse"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupJoin" name="Accommodation, bank and visa steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FinalVisaOutcome" name="Visa issued?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_WorkAndLive" name="Accommodation and bank negotiations completed; visa issued"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaNotIssued" name="Accommodation and bank negotiations completed; visa not issued"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_WorkAndLive" targetRef="Gateway_SetupSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_SetupJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_SetupJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle" targetRef="Gateway_SetupJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupJoin" targetRef="Gateway_FinalVisaOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalVisaOutcome" targetRef="End_WorkAndLive" name="Yes">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Visa issued</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalVisaOutcome" targetRef="End_VisaNotIssued" name="No">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Visa refused</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Representation" name="Process visa application at representation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ApplicationReceived" name="Visa application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewApplication" name="Review application and supporting evidence"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalEvidenceNeeded" name="Are additional documents needed?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestAdditionalDocuments" name="Request additional documents" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocumentsRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSupplementaryDocuments" name="Receive supplementary documents" messageRef="Message_SupplementaryDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessVisaRequirements" name="Assess requirements and check for grounds for refusal, including residence prohibition or a Schengen alert"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaDecision" name="Issue visa?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendVisaIssued" name="Issue visa and notify applicant" messageRef="Message_VisaIssued"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendVisaRefused" name="Notify applicant of refusal" messageRef="Message_VisaRefused"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepresentationIssued" name="Visa issued"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepresentationRefused" name="Visa refused"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R1" sourceRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_ReviewApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R2" sourceRef="Task_ReviewApplication" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalEvidenceNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R3" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalEvidenceNeeded" targetRef="Task_RequestAdditionalDocuments" name="Yes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R4" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalEvidenceNeeded" targetRef="Task_AssessVisaRequirements" name="No"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R5" sourceRef="Task_RequestAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSupplementaryDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSupplementaryDocuments" targetRef="Task_AssessVisaRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R7" sourceRef="Task_AssessVisaRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_VisaDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R8" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaDecision" targetRef="Task_SendVisaIssued" name="Yes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R9" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaDecision" targetRef="Task_SendVisaRefused" name="No"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R10" sourceRef="Task_SendVisaIssued" targetRef="End_RepresentationIssued"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R11" sourceRef="Task_SendVisaRefused" targetRef="End_RepresentationRefused"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Plan" name="Plan work and life in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupSplit" name="Start accommodation, bank and visa steps"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate a bank account"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_VisaCycle" name="Visa / Rot-Weiss-Rot Card requirements cycle (every x months)">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A further visa / Rot-Weiss-Rot Card cycle is due after x months</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_VisaCycle" name="Begin visa requirements cycle"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineCategory" name="Determine visa category"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Category" name="Category A/C or type D?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineMainDestination" name="Determine Schengen main destination by length and purpose of stay"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MainDestination" name="Can the main destination be determined?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectMainDestination" name="Select the country of the main destination"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFirstEntry" name="Select the country of first entry into the Schengen area"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DestinationMerge" name="Continue with responsible country"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompetenceAC" name="Identify the representation for the responsible country and the applicant's consular district of legal residence"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Legally resident but not registered in the competent consular district?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" name="Provide justification for applying to that consulate"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ACMerge" name="Continue with category A/C competence"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompetenceD" name="Identify the competent Austrian representation by place of residence and centre of interest, verifiable by documents such as registration forms, residence permits or visas"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompetenceMerge" name="Continue with competent representation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsultOfficeList" name="Consult the BMEIA list of representation offices, addresses, opening hours and special requirements"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact the representation in advance for more information"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteForm" name="Prepare the visa application form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Check that the travel document is valid in Austria, issued within the last ten years, has at least two empty pages, and remains valid at least three months beyond the visa duration"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePhoto" name="Prepare a passport photo meeting the criteria in portrait format, 35 x 45 mm"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInsurance" name="Obtain fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned stay, with 30,000 Euro cover throughout the Schengen area"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Prepare proof of sufficient means for the intended stay and return journey"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" name="Prepare other evidence requested by the authorities, noting that requirements may vary by location"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for other grounds for refusal, including a residence prohibition or a Schengen alert"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaCycle" name="Visa requirements cycle reviewed"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V1" sourceRef="Start_VisaCycle" targetRef="Task_DetermineCategory"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V2" sourceRef="Task_DetermineCategory" targetRef="Gateway_Category"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V3" sourceRef="Gateway_Category" targetRef="Task_DetermineMainDestination" name="Category A/C">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The visa category is A or C</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V4" sourceRef="Gateway_Category" targetRef="Task_CompetenceD" name="Type D">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The visa category is type D</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V5" sourceRef="Task_DetermineMainDestination" targetRef="Gateway_MainDestination"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V6" sourceRef="Gateway_MainDestination" targetRef="Task_SelectMainDestination" name="Yes">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The main destination can be determined</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V7" sourceRef="Gateway_MainDestination" targetRef="Task_SelectFirstEntry" name="No">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The main destination cannot be determined</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V8" sourceRef="Task_SelectMainDestination" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V9" sourceRef="Task_SelectFirstEntry" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V10" sourceRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge" targetRef="Task_CompetenceAC"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V11" sourceRef="Task_CompetenceAC" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V12" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" name="Yes">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The applicant is legally resident but not registered in the competent consular district</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V13" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Gateway_ACMerge" name="No">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The applicant is registered in the competent consular district</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V14" sourceRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_ACMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V15" sourceRef="Gateway_ACMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CompetenceMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V16" sourceRef="Task_CompetenceD" targetRef="Gateway_CompetenceMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V17" sourceRef="Gateway_CompetenceMerge" targetRef="Task_ConsultOfficeList"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V18" sourceRef="Task_ConsultOfficeList" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V19" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Task_CompleteForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V20" sourceRef="Task_CompleteForm" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V21" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Task_PreparePhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V22" sourceRef="Task_PreparePhoto" targetRef="Task_ObtainInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V23" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V24" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V25" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V26" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="End_VisaCycle"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupJoin" name="Accommodation, bank and visa steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Process" name="Accommodation, bank and visa requirements steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_Plan" targetRef="Gateway_SetupSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_SetupJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_SetupJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle" targetRef="Gateway_SetupJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupJoin" targetRef="End_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-and-live-in-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepresentationInformation" name="Request for visa information"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAndLive">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkAndLive"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Representation" name="Competent representation office"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepresentationInformation"
                      name="Request for visa information"
                      sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"
                      targetRef="Participant_Representation"
                      messageRef="Message_RepresentationInformation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAndLive" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Plan" name="Plan work and life in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupSplit" name="Start accommodation, bank and visa steps"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FindAccommodation" name="Identify a suitable accommodation option"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FindBank" name="Identify a suitable bank account option"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBank" name="Negotiate a bank account"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_VisaCycle" name="Visa / Rot-Weiss-Rot Card requirements cycle (every x months)">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A further visa / Rot-Weiss-Rot Card requirements cycle is due after x months</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_VisaCycle" name="Begin visa requirements cycle"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyIssuingAuthority" name="Identify the applicable visa-issuing authority: generally an overseas representation, or in specific exceptions certain border control posts or state police headquarters where extension is permitted"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExceptionalAuthority" name="Does a specific exception to representation-office issuance apply?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyExceptionalAuthority" name="Identify the certain border control post or state police headquarters for a permitted visa extension"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaCategory" name="Category A or C, or type D?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineMainDestination" name="Determine the Schengen main travel destination; for equal stays, use the length and purpose of stay"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MainDestination" name="Can the main travel destination be determined?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectMainDestination" name="Select the country of the main travel destination"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFirstEntry" name="Select the country of first entry into the Schengen area"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DestinationMerge" name="Continue with the responsible country"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompetenceAC" name="Identify the representation office in the consular district of the applicant's legal place of residence for the responsible country"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence" name="Is exceptional competence needed for an applicant legally resident but not registered in the district?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" name="Provide justification for submitting the application to that particular consulate"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ACMerge" name="Continue with category A/C competence"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompetenceD" name="Identify the competent Austrian representation for a type D visa by place of residence and centre of interest under Section 8 of the FPG, verifiable by documents such as registration forms, residence permits or visas"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepresentationMerge" name="Continue with the competent representation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsultOfficeList" name="Consult the BMEIA list of representation offices, addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours and special requirements"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact the representation in advance for more information"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfficeMerge" name="Continue with the applicable issuing authority"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" name="Prepare and check visa requirements"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteForm" name="Prepare the visa application form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Check that the travel document is valid in Austria, issued within the last ten years, has at least two empty pages, and remains valid at least three months beyond the visa duration"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePhoto" name="Prepare a passport photo meeting the specified criteria, in portrait format, 35 x 45 mm"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInsurance" name="Obtain fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned stay, with 30,000 Euro cover throughout the Schengen area"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Prepare proof of sufficient means for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" name="Prepare other evidence requested by the authorities, noting that requirements may vary by location and circumstances"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check the absence of other grounds for refusal, including a residence prohibition or a Schengen-country alert"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RequirementsJoin" name="Visa requirements prepared and checked"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaCycle" name="Visa requirements cycle reviewed"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V1" sourceRef="Start_VisaCycle" targetRef="Task_IdentifyIssuingAuthority"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V2" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyIssuingAuthority" targetRef="Gateway_ExceptionalAuthority"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V3" sourceRef="Gateway_ExceptionalAuthority" targetRef="Task_IdentifyExceptionalAuthority" name="Yes">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A specific exceptional issuing case applies</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V4" sourceRef="Gateway_ExceptionalAuthority" targetRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" name="No">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No specific exceptional issuing case applies</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V5" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_DetermineMainDestination" name="Category A or C">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The visa is category A or C</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V6" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_CompetenceD" name="Type D">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The visa is type D</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V7" sourceRef="Task_DetermineMainDestination" targetRef="Gateway_MainDestination"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V8" sourceRef="Gateway_MainDestination" targetRef="Task_SelectMainDestination" name="Yes">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The main travel destination can be determined</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V9" sourceRef="Gateway_MainDestination" targetRef="Task_SelectFirstEntry" name="No">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The main travel destination cannot be determined</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V10" sourceRef="Task_SelectMainDestination" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V11" sourceRef="Task_SelectFirstEntry" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V12" sourceRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge" targetRef="Task_CompetenceAC"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V13" sourceRef="Task_CompetenceAC" targetRef="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V14" sourceRef="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" name="Yes">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The applicant is legally resident but not registered in the district and seeks exceptional competence</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V15" sourceRef="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_ACMerge" name="No">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Exceptional competence is not sought</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V16" sourceRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_ACMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V17" sourceRef="Gateway_ACMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RepresentationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V18" sourceRef="Task_CompetenceD" targetRef="Gateway_RepresentationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V19" sourceRef="Gateway_RepresentationMerge" targetRef="Task_ConsultOfficeList"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V20" sourceRef="Task_ConsultOfficeList" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V21" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_OfficeMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V22" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyExceptionalAuthority" targetRef="Gateway_OfficeMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V23" sourceRef="Gateway_OfficeMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V24" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V25" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V26" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V27" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ObtainInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V28" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V29" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V30" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V31" sourceRef="Task_CompleteForm" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V32" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V33" sourceRef="Task_PreparePhoto" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V34" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V35" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V36" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V37" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V38" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin" targetRef="End_VisaCycle"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupJoin" name="Accommodation, bank and visa steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Process" name="Accommodation, bank and visa requirements steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_Plan" targetRef="Gateway_SetupSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupSplit" targetRef="Task_FindAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_FindAccommodation" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_SetupJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupSplit" targetRef="Task_FindBank"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_FindBank" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBank"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBank" targetRef="Gateway_SetupJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="SubProcess_VisaCycle" targetRef="Gateway_SetupJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupJoin" targetRef="End_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description lists multiple distinct documents or prerequisites that must be provided or checked as part of an application.: Model each actionable document-related preparation or verification as a separate activity before the application is assessed, and preserve any dependencies stated in the description.
rules.situation: the description lists multiple distinct documents or prerequisites that must be provided or checked as part of an application.

rules.instruction: When the description identifies actions or outcomes at distinct stages of a process: Label each BPMN element to reflect the action or outcome described at that stage; do not substitute a different action, a later-stage action, or an unsupported outcome.
rules.situation: the description states activities or decisions with identifiable actions, objects, or outcomes

rules.instruction: When the description gives eligibility or document conditions and institutional context but does not specify how the procedure is carried out, how responses are handled, or what outcomes follow: Model only the activities, decisions, and results stated in the description; do not add application steps, response waits, or outcomes.
rules.situation: the description gives eligibility or document conditions and institutional context but does not specify how the procedure is carried out, how responses are handled, or what outcomes follow

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes activities or outcomes by their action, object, recipient, or stage: Use BPMN labels that preserve those stated distinctions rather than substituting a different action or outcome.
rules.situation: the description states an activity or decision criterion

rules.instruction: When the description says a resource must be arranged by discussing terms with its provider: Model identifying a suitable option as a distinct activity before discussing terms with the provider, and connect the activities with a sequence flow.
rules.situation: the description says a resource must be arranged by discussing terms with its provider

promoted.trigger: the description identifies multiple distinct items that must be prepared or verified before a later step.
promoted.instruction: Model each actionable preparation or verification as a separate activity before the dependent activity, preserving stated dependencies.
